_comment: Curated Wikidata QIDs of VERIFIED Tamil-Nadu-born singers that the SPARQL harvest (scripts/fetch-artists.ts) misses — either because their Wikidata occupation (P106) is not singer/a singer-subclass, or because their entry has no place of birth (P19). The fetch step force-includes these QIDs as candidates, pulling name/birthplace/sitelinks/image from Wikidata (never invented). For a seed whose birthplace cannot be resolved to a current district from Wikidata alone, add a reviewed, CITED entry to manual-overrides.json (birthplaceDistrict). Every seed must be a genuine singer born in Tamil Nadu, confirmed against a real source. Never add a singer born outside Tamil Nadu — rule 2 groups by birthplace district.

seeds.name: Sid Sriram
seeds.reason: Playback singer born in Chennai; Wikidata lists occupation as songwriter/musician (not singer), so the occupation-filtered harvest skips him. Birthplace (P19 = Chennai) resolves normally once included.

seeds.name: Sirkazhi Govindarajan
seeds.reason: Carnatic vocalist and Tamil-cinema playback singer born in Sirkazhi; Wikidata occupation is actor/recording artist (not singer), so the harvest skips him. Birthplace (P19 = Sirkazhi) resolves via admin hierarchy to Nagapattinam/Mayiladuthurai.

seeds.name: Saindhavi
seeds.reason: Carnatic vocalist and playback singer; Wikidata has occupation singer but no place of birth (P19), so the birthplace filter excludes her. District supplied via cited manual override (Chennai).

seeds.name: Anthony Daasan
seeds.reason: Tamil folk/playback singer; Wikidata has occupation singer but no place of birth (P19). District supplied via cited manual override (Ariyalur).

seeds.name: Paravai Muniyamma
seeds.reason: Folk/playback singer (and actress); Wikidata occupation is actor and P19 is only the state (Tamil Nadu), so no district resolves. District supplied via cited manual override (Madurai — her birthplace Paravai is a town in Madurai district).
